name: technitium-dns
title: Technitium DNS
description: Technitium is a DNS server with a web page: it resolves names itself or forwards them (DNS-over-HTTPS and DNS-over-TLS included), blocks ads from block lists and hosts your own zones. After deploying, sign in as admin with the password you set here, then point your router or devices at this server's DNS port; set that port to 53 once nothing else on the host uses it. To run it from DCS (numbers, block and allow, the kids' groups and their bedtime, a second server kept in step), make an API token in Technitium (your name at the top right → Create API Token) and connect it on the Technitium page under DNS & routes.

variables.name: PORT_TECHNITIUM_WEB
variables.label: Web port
variables.description: Host port of the web page

variables.name: PORT_TECHNITIUM_DNS
variables.label: DNS port
variables.description: TCP and UDP. 5353 by default because many servers already have a resolver on 53; devices on your network can only use it as their DNS server on port 53

variables.name: TECHNITIUM_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.label: Admin password
variables.description: Password of the admin user, set on the first start

variables.name: TECHNITIUM_DOMAIN
variables.label: Server name
variables.description: The name this DNS server gives itself, for example dns.home.arpa
